quests.instruction: Which emotion do we feel when we are going to the amusement park?
quests.question: Excited
quests.hint: This is a feeling of being excited.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Feeling excited gives your body extra energy to play and celebrate!

quests.instruction: Which emotion do we feel when things do not go our way?
quests.question: Angry
quests.hint: This is a feeling of being angry.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Taking slow, deep breaths can help you calm down when you are angry.

quests.instruction: Which emotion do we feel when we smile and laugh out loud?
quests.question: Happy
quests.hint: This is a feeling of being happy.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Smiling when you feel happy can make other people smile too!

quests.instruction: Which emotion do we feel when we have tears when we are hurt?
quests.question: Sad
quests.hint: This is a feeling of being sad.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: It is okay to feel sad. Talking to someone can help you feel better.

quests.instruction: Which emotion do we feel when we hear a loud sound in the dark?
quests.question: Scared
quests.hint: This is a feeling of being scared.
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: Being brave means trying even when you feel scared!
